title: How We Make Your Plate
description: See the care and craftsmanship that goes into creating your personalised motorcycle plate.
closeLabel: Close how we make your plate

steps.title: Precision laser cutting
steps.description: Your chosen registration and plate details are precision cut to create clean, accurate lettering and edges.
steps.alt: A registration plate being precision cut by a laser machine

steps.title: Masking removal
steps.description: The protective masking is carefully removed to reveal the precisely cut registration and border details.
steps.alt: A cut motorcycle plate after its protective masking has been removed

steps.title: Glossy black finishing
steps.description: Glossy black finishing is applied to produce the deep, crisp detail selected for your plate design.
steps.alt: A motorcycle plate showing its glossy black finishing stage

steps.title: Mirror Silver finishing
steps.description: Where selected, Mirror Silver detailing is applied to create a bright, distinctive finish around the design.
steps.alt: A motorcycle plate showing its Mirror Silver finishing stage

steps.title: Reflective layer and inspection
steps.description: The reflective yellow layer is applied before the completed plate is carefully checked and prepared for dispatch.
steps.alt: A completed yellow motorcycle number plate ready for final inspection
